lines.2: 「I put on a brave face for Subaru, but now that I think about it calmly, this seems impossible.」
lines.3: 「Love and baseball both start with two outs.」
lines.6: 「I know you're doing this for the Princess, Leo, but you don't have to get so worked up. You don't need to chase some huge achievement right away.」
lines.8: 「I don't want to hear that from you, idiot.」
lines.13: I give her cheeks a long, hard pull.
lines.14: 「Wh-What do you mean, you never asked?! I went out of my way to...!」
lines.15: 「Your eyes water right away whenever I pull your cheeks.」
lines.16: Her tear ducts are way too loose.
lines.17: 「I'm not crying! I said I'm not crying!」
